duplicate_open_ambiguity_verdict.finding: The retained real ES schedule contains a duplicate-open ambiguity. The reconciler correctly rejects this with SessionGapError('duplicate schedule event') at line 96. This is an authoritative-evidence blocker — it is NOT normalized to a valid session.

observations.description: Exact schedule/manifest SHA-256 binding: manifest raw_sha256 must match sha256(schedule_bytes), raw_bytes must match len(schedule_bytes). Tampered schedule (extra byte) rejects.
Repository-relative path containment: no absolute, drive letter, or parent traversal. resolve(strict=True) catches nonexistent. Must be a file inside repository.
ES/NQ-only market (BTC rejects). XCME-only venue (OTHER rejects). NQ accepted with correct manifest.
Exact product_name binding: must match schedule records, must be non-empty, manifest root must match market.
Complete non-paginated: status==OK, results is list, no next_url. Missing/non-list results reject.

Unique pre_open/open/close events (duplicate rejects). Strict UTC chronology (pre_open<=open<close). Missing events and unknown events reject. Overlapping sessions reject. Non-UTC and naive timestamps reject. Invalid session dates reject.
Classification: SCHEDULED_NON_TRADING_INTERVAL (0 overlap), MISSING_OPEN_SESSION_DATA (full overlap), MIXED_REQUIRES_SPLIT (partial overlap). Deterministic by overlap_seconds vs gap_seconds.
Gaps outside schedule coverage (start<schedule_start or end>schedule_end) reject. Non-1m timeframe rejects.
No maintenance/weekend/holiday subtype. Only 3 GapClassification values. Documentation states 'does not guess' subtype.
Deterministic immutable: reconciliation_id=canonical_fingerprint, replay produces identical result, frozen dataclass, version constant.
trading_authority=False always, even with empty gaps.
No network/credential/trading imports. Only dataclass, datetime, enum, hashlib, json, pathlib used.
Duplicate-open ambiguity: duplicate event for same session date rejects with 'duplicate schedule event'. Correctly treated as authoritative-evidence blocker, NOT normalized.
Manifest verification: endpoint_class==futures_schedules, http_status==200, automatic_retry==False, raw_relative_path must endswith manifest path, missing manifest fields reject.

redundant: Some adversarial tests overlap with existing on tampered schedule, outside coverage, wrong timeframe, wrong product/market
